**For: 195cm, 120kg athlete | Goal: Muscle Gain**

---

## Nutritional Targets
- **Calories:** ~3,200-3,500 kcal
- **Protein:** 180-200g (1.5g per lb bodyweight)
- **Carbs:** 400-450g
- **Fat:** 90-110g

---

- 1 cup oats

---

- 50g whey protein powder
- 1 cup white rice or 2 slices white bread

- Water or milk

**Nutritional breakdown:** 450 kcal | 40g protein | 55g carbs | 3g fat

---

---

## AFTERNOON SNACK (4:00 PM)

- 50g granola

**Nutritional breakdown:** 450 kcal | 30g protein | 45g carbs | 18g fat

---

## DINNER (7:00 PM)
**Lean Beef with Sweet Potato**

- 2 medium sweet potatoes
- 150g mixed green salad
- 1 tbsp olive oil dressing

**Nutritional breakdown:** 700 kcal | 45g protein | 75g carbs | 20g fat

---

- **Total Protein:** 230g
- **Total Carbs:** 340g

✅ Drink 3-4 liters of water daily  
✅ Time carbs around workouts for energy  
✅ Adjust portions based on training intensity  
✅ Consider a multivitamin & omega-3 supplement  
✅ Get 7-9 hours of sleep for recovery

# One-Day Vegan Meal Plan for Marathon Training
**For: 165cm, 55kg athlete**

---

## BREAKFAST (7:00 AM)
**Carb-Loading Oatmeal Bowl**
- 1 cup cooked oatmeal (150g)
- 1 banana, sliced
- 2 tbsp almond butter
- 1 tbsp ground flaxseed
- ½ cup unsweetened almond milk
- Pinch of cinnamon

**Nutrition:** ~450 cal | 15g protein | 65g carbs | 12g fat

---

## MID-MORNING SNACK (10:00 AM)
**Pre-Run Fuel**
- 1 energy bar (dates + nuts, vegan)
- 1 medium apple
- 250ml coconut water

**Nutrition:** ~250 cal | 6g protein | 52g carbs | 5g fat

---

## LUNCH (1:00 PM)
**Quinoa Buddha Bowl**
- 1 cup cooked quinoa
- 1 cup roasted chickpeas
- 2 cups mixed greens
- ½ cup shredded beets
- ½ avocado
- 2 tbsp tahini dressing
- Squeeze of lemon

**Nutrition:** ~550 cal | 20g protein | 58g carbs | 22g fat

---

## AFTERNOON SNACK (4:00 PM)
**Recovery Smoothie**
- 1 cup unsweetened soy milk
- 1 scoop vegan protein powder
- ½ cup frozen berries
- 1 tbsp chia seeds
- 1 tbsp maple syrup

**Nutrition:** ~280 cal | 25g protein | 32g carbs | 6g fat

---

## DINNER (7:00 PM)
**Lentil & Sweet Potato Pasta**
- 1.5 cups cooked lentil pasta
- 1 cup roasted sweet potato chunks
- 1 cup steamed broccoli
- ½ cup marinara sauce
- 2 tbsp nutritional yeast
- 1 tbsp olive oil

**Nutrition:** ~520 cal | 18g protein | 78g carbs | 10g fat

---

## EVENING SNACK (9:00 PM)
**Recovery Fuel**
- 1 slice whole grain toast
- 2 tbsp peanut butter
- ½ banana

**Nutrition:** ~280 cal | 10g protein | 32g carbs | 12g fat

---

## DAILY TOTALS
| Metric | Amount |
|--------|--------|
| **Calories** | ~2,330 |
| **Protein** | ~94g (16% of intake) |
| **Carbohydrates** | ~317g (55% of intake) |
| **Fat** | ~67g (26% of intake) |
| **Fiber** | ~38g |

---

## KEY NOTES FOR MARATHON TRAINING

✅ **Carb-focused** (55%) to fuel endurance  
✅ **Complete proteins** from legumes, tofu, nuts, and seeds  
✅ **Adequate B12** - consider a supplement (critical for vegans)  
✅ **Iron-rich foods** - lentils, quinoa, leafy greens  
✅ **Omega-3s** - flaxseed, chia, walnuts  
✅ **Hydration** - add 2-3L water daily, more on training days  

**Consider supplementing:** B12, Vitamin D, Iron (if deficient), Omega-3 algae supplement
